blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Municipality of Bantayan disposed of 178 sacks of 50-kilogram rice on Thursday, October 8, 2026, after the stock spoiled. These sacks of rice were discovered in July 2025 when Mayor Alex Layese took office.
